adds.title: Agencia Diadorim - research/report on Santa Catarina
adds.summary: From January 2019 to June 2025 Santa Catarina state deputies introduced 19 anti-LGBTQIA+ bills versus 4 pro-LGBTQIA+ bills, including proposals to prohibit neutral language in official government communications and to bar minors from hormone therapy, surgical interventions and other gender-transition care, with 4 of the anti-LGBTQIA+ bills archived and none enacted.

adds.title: Office of Florianopolis Councilor Leonel Camasao (PSOL) - 2026 report
adds.summary: From January 2015 to October 2025 Santa Catarina's Legislative Assembly and its 295 municipal chambers approved or advanced at least 271 unconstitutional laws, bills and normative acts already declared unconstitutional by the STF, 41% attacking gender and sexuality with particular focus on LGBTIA+ people, with 36% already in force and only 11% judicially annulled, concentrated in the Vale do Itajaí and accelerating in the last five years.

adds.title: Supreme Federal Court decision 2019
adds.summary: On 13 June 2019 Brazil's Supreme Federal Court voted by 8 of 11 justices to criminalize homophobia under existing racism legislation until Congress creates a specific law, affirming that sexual orientation and gender identity are essential to self-determination and the pursuit of happiness.

adds.title: Constitutional Amendment No. 59 - Sergipe
adds.summary: On 17 December 2025 Sergipe amended article 3(II) of the State Constitution to guarantee state-level protection against discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity with violators subject to punishment by law, effective upon promulgation.
